evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete selected PE exception families, native bytes, local control boundaries, fixed normal frames, unsigned guards, pointer stores, vector lanes and low-byte decisions.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Actual source CALLs to the selector and pointer projection; selected argument and result transfer slices.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Normal finite returns and valid stable disjoint storage; anonymous child results and fresh memory reads remain opaque.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Three physical registration indices, anonymous context QWORDs, object fields and cache globals; managed identity is not inferred from offsets.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Whole lookup-pass/cache semantics, normalization values, registration-cell startup binding, concrete DamageType compiled sharing, provider selection, recursive Buff root admission and runtime action effects.
